reason: In mosses, 'seta present/absent' is the stalk of the sporophyte, PO_0030032. The pappus 'setae' are a different part, pappus element PO_0025394 (synonym pappus bristle), and need their own bearer rule, not this one.
Veins, costa or sutures standing out from the surface. This is the same reading as the earlier rule for 'elevated' (C320); 'sharply' is a degree word and stays in the record.
aculeate = prickly, as in the earlier rule C307. 'sparsely' is a density qualifier kept in the record, not part of the value.
'leaf blade: top acute' uses 'top' for the apex of the part being described, as the earlier rule for 'apex' (C266) does. The quality that follows it is the value.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (part of the bearer): vascular bundle (PO_0005020) of the bearer + purple, value_qualifier approximately
reason: The colour is a quality of the veins, not of the flower, leaf or corolla. 'Purplish' is the approximate value of purple.
'Primary bracts like the scape-bracts' compares the bracts with another named part. FLOPO:0991200 bract-like would say nothing about a bract.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound of two values): curved (PATO_0000406) + secund (FLOPO:0991146)
reason: Moss leaves that are both curved and turned to one side. Both values exist, so the word is two annotations on one bearer, not a new term.
'Scarcely manifest' (Latin vix manifestus) means hardly visible, the same reading as the earlier rules for 'obscure' and 'indistinct' (C174, C175).

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound of two values): raceme-like (FLOPO:0991197) + decreased length
reason: 'Flowers short-racemose' means the flowers are in short racemes. That is an inflorescence type and a length, two values, not one quality.
calvescent = becoming bald, which is the definition of glabrescent. 'calvescenl' is an OCR form of the same word.
Rose colour lightened, which is PATO's pink with high brightness and low saturation.

target: docs/odp/00-part-and-quality.md on the teeth: denticulate on the bearer + callus-tipped (FLOPO:0991346) on its teeth
reason: A margin with minute teeth that end in callosities. The callus is a quality of the teeth, so a rule over the existing values is better than a compound term.
Glands, veins or branches whose spacing or arrangement lacks consistency. PATO_0000330 is defined for repeated parts in exactly this way.
pergamaceous = parchment-like. The earlier rule C333 maps 'parchment-like' to papyraceous.
This is the English form of triplinerved, which already exists in FLOPO.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (part of the bearer): beak of the perigynium/fruit + colour value
reason: A colour stated of the beak, a part of the bearer. The label was made by the transcriber; the quality is the colour word (green, brown).
'Broadly' only widens the same shape. The value is rhomboid and the modifier stays in the record.
An indefinite count ('few') of stems on a plant, the same kind of word as 'few-flowered'.
'Embedded in tomentum / pulp / soil' needs the thing it is embedded in. Without it the word is incomplete.
A surface dotted with resin glands. gland-dotted (a child of punctate PATO_0001512) covers glands in or on the tissue.
A compound shape, X-Y between X and Y, is the continuum pattern of the playbook. 'rhombie' is an OCR form.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound of two values): scarious (FLOPO:0991047) + sheathing (FLOPO:0991105)
reason: Both qualities hold together: a sheathing base that is scarious. That is two annotations with existing values, not an intermediate.

label: semiobcordate
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being one half of an obcordate figure divided lengthwise, with one side nearly straight and the other curved and notched at the distal end.
reason: An asymmetric legume wing shape. It sits beside the existing FLOPO:0991318 semiovate and FLOPO:0991349 semicordate, and no term covers it.
An OCR form of subtruncate, which is nearly truncate: the approximate value of PATO_0000936.
A secondary yellow hue. The value is yellow with an approximate or 'tinged' qualifier, and a base colour, if stated, is a second value.
Palmate venation means three or more primary veins radiating from one point, which is PATO's definition of actinodromous.
The definition of sheathing already places the sheath at the bearer's base, so 'base sheathing' is the same value.
A multi-headed caudex divides into several crowns, so it is branched. FLOPO:0991366 multistemmed is for a whole plant, not a caudex.

label: syncolpate
definition: A structural quality inhering in a pollen grain by virtue of its colpi meeting and fusing at the poles.
reason: A general aperture type with no term. The existing FLOPO:0991361 trisyncolpate would become its child.

label: colporate
definition: A structural quality inhering in a pollen grain by virtue of its apertures being compound, each a furrow-like colpus with an inner pore (endoaperture).
reason: A standard aperture type with no PATO or FLOPO term. Its number prefix ('4-colporate') goes through the count pattern 03.
